newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy July cumulative PSBR 61.87 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy July cumulative PSBR 61.87 trln lire.

text.p: Italy's cumulative public sector borrowing requirement was 61.87 trillion lire at end-July 1996 compared with 56.11 trillion in July 1995, the Treasury Ministry said in a statement.
Receipts totalled 301.0 trillion lire over the period against expenditure of 357.3 trillion, but this gap was partially widened by a net deficit on Treasury management operations of 9.17 trillion.
Medium- and long-term domestic borrowing over the period raised 82.67 trillion, while 7.69 trillion was raised on international markets.
The volume of short-term Treasury bills in circulation fell 10.5 trillion lire to 401.51 trillion at end-July from 412.014 trillion at end-December 1995.
